text: What is Apple HomeView? Apple's $299 smart display, explained. Apple HomeView is Apple's first smart home display: a $299 device with a 7-inch square screen and speaker that controls smart home gadgets, plays music, makes FaceTime calls and runs Apple's new Siri AI. Apple announced it on Oct. 13, 2026, and it goes on sale in the U.S. On Friday, Nov. 13, 2026.. Apple's HomeView smart display, announced Oct. 13, 2026, goes on sale in the U.S. On Nov. 13.. HomeView comes in two versions at the same $299 price: a tabletop model on a domed speaker base with a tilting stainless steel hinge, and a wall-mounted model. According to 9to5Mac, the tabletop version comes in silver, starlight, rose pink and space gray, and the wall version in space gray and silver. Wall mounts made with Schneider Home start at $59.95 for a USB-C connector and $79.95 for an AC wired mount; a $129.95 Power over Ethernet mount is due in early 2027. The 7-inch Liquid Retina display reaches 500 nits and can dim to 0.3 nits for a nightstand. A Center Stage front camera handles FaceTime calls. The device recognizes up to six people and shows each one a personal Home Screen with their messages, calendar and contacts. Preloaded apps include Calendar, Messages, Photos, FaceTime, Notes, Reminders, Music and Podcasts. It works by touch or voice, has an intercom feature and can show up to nine home camera feeds at once. Siri on HomeView can view camera feeds, adjust a thermostat, turn on lights and lock doors. People with an Apple Intelligence-capable iPhone or iPad get Siri answers that use their personal context. 9to5Mac reports HomeView will not be sold in the European Union, where Apple's Siri AI is not available.

What is Pico Park? The co-op game behind Sonic Pico Park. Pico Park is a cooperative puzzle-platformer from the Japanese indie studio TECOPARK in which every player must work together to reach the goal. It first came out on Steam on April 26, 2016. A Sonic the Hedgehog version, Sonic Pico Park, launches Nov. 12, 2026, for 2 to 8 players.. Sonic Pico Park, a Sonic the Hedgehog take on the Pico Park co-op series, releases on Nov. 12, 2026.. In Pico Park, players control small, identical characters, and no one can finish a stage alone: the group has to cooperate to solve each puzzle and reach the goal. The game later came to Nintendo Switch. The current version supports 2 to 8 players, and the free Classic Edition supported up to 10. Wikipedia credits a developer known as Teco as its designer, programmer and artist, and estimates the game has sold more than 230,000 copies. A sequel, Pico Park 2, came out on Switch on Aug. 27, 2024, and on PC and Xbox on Sept. 12, 2024. The free Pico Park: Classic Edition was pulled from the Steam store on June 14, 2026, after TECOPARK announced its removal on June 1. Sonic Pico Park, also written "SONIC PICO PARK," blends the series with Sega's Sonic games: every character can use Sonic's Spin Dash, and stages add rings, loops and springs. Players reach the goal plate at the right side of each stage. It releases Nov. 12, 2026, on PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X/S, Nintendo Switch 2, Nintendo Switch and PC (Steam), with local and online play and online cross-play.
